reports.question: Top 10 products by total sales amount using readable ProductName (join dbo.VwAISalesData with dbo.VwMstItems on ItemId)
reports.sql:
SELECT TOP (10) 
    i.Description AS ProductName, 
    SUM(s.SaleNetAmount) AS TotalSalesAmount
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData s
JOIN dbo.VwMstItems i ON s.ItemId = i.ItemId
GROUP BY i.Description
ORDER BY TotalSalesAmount DESC

reports.question: Sum of SaleNetAmount grouped by BranchId
reports.sql:
SELECT TOP (100) BranchId, SUM(SaleNetAmount) AS TotalSaleNetAmount
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData
GROUP BY BranchId

reports.question: Highest revenue salesperson this month by SaleNetAmount
reports.sql:
SELECT TOP (1) 
    dbo.VwAISalesPerson.SalesPersonId, 
    dbo.VwAISalesPerson.SalesPersonName, 
    SUM(dbo.VwAISalesData.SaleNetAmount) AS TotalRevenue
FROM 
    dbo.VwAISalesData
JOIN 
    dbo.VwAISalesPerson ON dbo.VwAISalesData.SalesPersonId = dbo.VwAISalesPerson.SalesPersonId
WHERE 
    YEAR(dbo.VwAISalesData.InvoiceDt) = YEAR(GETDATE()) 
    AND MONTH(dbo.VwAISalesData.InvoiceDt) = MONTH(GETDATE())
GROUP BY 
    dbo.VwAISalesPerson.SalesPersonId, 
    dbo.VwAISalesPerson.SalesPersonName
ORDER BY 
    TotalRevenue DESC

reports.question: Today's sales transactions with InvoiceNo, InvoiceDt, ItemId, Quantity, SaleNetAmount
reports.sql:
SELECT TOP (100) InvoiceNo, InvoiceDt, ItemId, Quantity, SaleNetAmount 
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData 
WHERE InvoiceDt >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND InvoiceDt < DATEADD(day, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))

reports.question: Low stock items — quantity less than 10
reports.sql:
SELECT TOP (100) ItemId, BranchId, StockQty 
FROM dbo.VwAIStockData 
WHERE StockQty < 10

reports.question: Top 20 customers by total SaleNetAmount
reports.sql:
SELECT TOP (20) CustomerId, SUM(SaleNetAmount) AS TotalSaleNetAmount
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData
GROUP BY CustomerId
ORDER BY TotalSaleNetAmount DESC

reports.question: Monthly sales trend for the last 6 months by InvoiceDt
reports.sql:
SELECT TOP (100) 
    YEAR(InvoiceDt) AS SalesYear, 
    MONTH(InvoiceDt) AS SalesMonth, 
    SUM(SaleNetAmount) AS TotalSales
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData
WHERE InvoiceDt >= DATEADD(month, -6, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
GROUP BY YEAR(InvoiceDt), MONTH(InvoiceDt)
ORDER BY SalesYear, SalesMonth

reports.question: Branches with zero sales in the last 7 days
reports.sql:
SELECT TOP (100) b.BranchId, b.BranchName
FROM dbo.VwAIBranch b
LEFT JOIN dbo.VwAISalesData s ON b.BranchId = s.BranchId AND s.InvoiceDt >= DATEADD(day, -7, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
GROUP BY b.BranchId, b.BranchName
HAVING COUNT(s.InvoiceId) = 0

reports.question: Top 10 vendors by purchase amount from purchase report (use amount/value column, not quantity)
reports.sql:
SELECT TOP (10) SupplierName, SUM(PurQty * ItemMRP) AS TotalPurchaseAmount
FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PUR_REPORT
GROUP BY SupplierName
ORDER BY TotalPurchaseAmount DESC

reports.question: Average order value by branch using SaleNetAmount per InvoiceId
reports.sql:
SELECT TOP (100) BranchId, AVG(SaleNetAmount) AS AverageOrderValue
FROM dbo.VwAISalesData
GROUP BY BranchId
